about: Targets interrupt_gate@vN must reach on interrupt_gate_golden.json through the real watch (pre-filter, redaction, router, parser, threshold 0.7): precision and recall of 'an interruption is posted', reason_accuracy among the true positives, false_positive_rate over the negatives, parse_failure_rate over the model answers. A wrong interruption costs the person focus, so precision and the false-positive rate are the headline. Not yet measured live: the offline gate replays the simulated recording (source: simulated); the coordinator runs the live eval (EVAL_LIVE=1 EVAL_RECORD=1) to record real answers and set measured.
